advanced.name: Advanced settings
advanced.description: The defaults suit an electricity meter that updates every 10 seconds. The measurement window must be longer than the meter's update interval plus the time it takes for the value to reach Home Assistant. A window that is too short makes the charge current oscillate.

data_description.estimate_window_seconds: How far back the charger's current is compared with each phase value. Default 15 s, allowed 3–30 s.
data_description.up_hold_seconds: How long the household load must have stayed low before the charge current is raised. Default 90 s, allowed 0–600 s.

error.no_phases: At least one phase sensor (L1) must be configured.
error.duplicate_phase_sensors: The same sensor cannot be used for multiple phases. Each phase must have a unique current sensor.
error.max_less_than_min: Maximum charge current must be at least as large as minimum charge current.
error.safe_current_out_of_range: Safe default current must be between 6 and 16 A
error.estimate_window_out_of_range: The measurement window must be a whole number of seconds between 3 and 30.
error.up_hold_out_of_range: The hold time must be a whole number of seconds between 0 and 600.
error.advanced_out_of_range: The measurement window must be a whole number of seconds between 3 and 30, and the hold time a whole number of seconds between 0 and 600.
